result.title: JAXbounce: A Continuous-Control Pong-Like Benchmark for Active Inference Beyond Low Dimensional Environments
result.comment: Published in the Springer CCIS series as part of the 7th International Workshop on Active Inference (IWAI26)
result.summary: We introduce JAXbounce, a continuous control pong-like benchmark designed to evaluate active inference beyond discrete, low dimensional environments. JAXbounce combines continuous states and stochastic dynamics in discrete time with flexible and composable observation models that allow representing the environment as a state vector or a pixel grid, corruptible through the rich family of noise models we provide. It is fully differentiable and parallelisable in JAX. We run over 10,000 agent simulations on our environment comparing a baseline deterministic solution, to a state-based active inference agent with Unscented Kalman Filter perception and expected free energy planning, and a pixel based agent whose measurement model is a pretrained neural network encoder. All agents are evaluated across three scenarios of increasing difficulty with eight different noise conditions. Our experiments characterise how performance of continuous state agents scales with planning, planning horizons, observation modalities and knowledge of the noise process, exhibiting preference-oriented behaviour even in the presence of increasing uncertainty. We release JAXbounce as a reproducible benchmark for continuous control active inference research.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 JAXbounce：一个基于 JAX、可微且可并行化的连续控制 Pong 类基准，含连续状态、随机动力学、状态向量或像素网格等可组合观测模型及多种噪声；并比较确定性基线、使用无迹卡尔曼滤波感知与期望自由能规划的 active inference 智能体，以及像素编码器智能体在不同难度与噪声下的表现。
AI.relevance_reason: 其期望自由能规划、信念状态更新与不确定性下的观测选择，可能为 LVR 中「何时继续获取视觉证据、何时停止」及噪声下证据筛选提供问题表述线索，但属于连续控制基准，与 VLM 内部 latent 推理距离较远，需核查可迁移性。
